name: I Put a Spell on You

podcast.body: Screamin' Jay Hawkins and his band recorded this sweet ballad after getting drunk in the studio, with Hawkins blacking out and not remembering the session. The resulting recording was far from a ballad and became infamous, leading to its ban from radio in some places due to complaints of being too sexual, evil, and deviant in 1956. "The results was not a ballad."
